tool.name: MFEM Coil Geometry
tool.description: Define MiniMak coil electrical and physical parameters for MFEM field analysis
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/mfem_coil_geometry.py' --tf1-radius '$tf1_radius' --tf2-radius '$tf2_radius' --pf1-radius '$pf1_radius' --pf2-radius '$pf2_radius' --tf-turns $tf_turns --pf-turns $pf_turns --tf-resistance '$tf_resistance' --pf-resistance '$pf_resistance' --output-csv output.csv --output-png output.png && mv output.csv '$output_csv' && mv output.png '$output_png'

param.name: tf1_radius
param.label: TF bank 1 radius (m)
param.help: Radius of the TF bank 1 coil loop

param.name: tf2_radius
param.label: TF bank 2 radius (m)
param.help: Radius of the TF bank 2 coil loop

param.name: pf1_radius
param.label: PF bank 1 radius (m)
param.help: Radius of the PF bank 1 ring from the machine axis

param.name: pf2_radius
param.label: PF bank 2 radius (m)
param.help: Radius of the PF bank 2 ring from the machine axis

param.name: tf_turns
param.label: TF coil turns
param.help: Number of turns per TF coil bank

param.name: pf_turns
param.label: PF coil turns
param.help: Number of turns per PF coil bank

param.name: tf_resistance
param.label: TF coil resistance (ohm)
param.help: Resistance of each TF coil bank - used to convert voltage to current

param.name: pf_resistance
param.label: PF coil resistance (ohm)
param.help: Resistance of each PF coil bank - used to convert voltage to current

data.name: output_csv
data.label: Coil geometry (CSV)
data.help: Geometry CSV with coil_id, radius_m, turns, resistance_ohm - feed into MFEM Time Series Demo

data.name: output_png
data.label: Coil geometry plot (PNG)
data.help: 3-D visualisation of the defined coil geometry

tool.help:
**MFEM Coil Geometry**
Defines the physical and electrical parameters for each MiniMak coil bank and outputs a geometry CSV that can be passed directly to the **MFEM Time Series Demo** tool.
This tool replaces the geometry definition step that was previously bundled inside the MFEM Coil Demo tool, allowing geometry to be defined once and reused across multiple MFEM timeseries runs.
**Coil banks**
+------+-----------+----------------------------------------------+ | ID | Name | Description | +------+-----------+----------------------------------------------+ | tf1 | TF bank 1 | Toroidal field coils, first bank (4 coils) | | tf2 | TF bank 2 | Toroidal field coils, second bank (4 coils) | | pf1 | PF bank 1 | Poloidal field upper ring | | pf2 | PF bank 2 | Poloidal field lower ring | +------+-----------+----------------------------------------------+
**Default radii** match the MiniMak parametric coil generator defaults: - TF coil radius: 0.075 m (cross-sectional loop radius) - PF coil radius: 0.12 m (ring radius from machine axis)
**Output CSV columns**::
coil_id, coil_name, radius_m, turns, resistance_ohm
Feed this CSV directly into the **MFEM Time Series Demo** geometry input.
